cases.reason: A negative read can accompany pending or committed effect; retry may duplicate and waiting has no fairness.
Settle consumes pending work and gives a final negative or committed result; only final negative permits send.
Both replica labels are possible in both safe worlds and reveal no completion knowledge.
A foreign receipt is observationally identical to this operation receipt.
Identity-bound status separates foreign receipts, allowing completion without duplicate effect.
Inspect separates partial states; the none branch requires both missing components.
A valid deduplication key makes retry safe without any status operation.
Unknown key expiration admits duplicate retry; key validity is hidden and no sensing exists.
Classify, conditional detail, and the matching resolution are needed in b/c histories.
Cancellation acknowledgment does not prove quiescence; a pending poll branch can persist forever.
Cancel then drain reaches known quiescence; drain is unavailable before acknowledgment.
Every pair of initial worlds has a safe action, but no action is enabled in all three.
At horizon zero the initial safe goal already holds; no unnecessary action is required.
A formerly active response may race with revocation; no observation licenses a universally safe use.
